occurrences.exact_quote:
| Titan line | Descendants | Function carried into later generations |
|--------|--------|--------|
| **Cronus + Rhea** | Hestia, Demeter, Hera, Hades, Poseidon, **Zeus** | Sovereignty, differentiated domains, succession |
| **Coeus + Phoebe** | **Leto**, Asteria | Prophetic and oracular associations |
| **Leto + Zeus** | **Apollo, Artemis** | Music, prophecy, lunar/hunting associations |
| **Hyperion + Theia** | **Helios, Selene, Eos** | Sun, moon, dawn - differentiated light and timekeeping |
| **Oceanus + Tethys** | River gods and Oceanids | Waters, circulation, boundaries |
| **Iapetus + Clymene/Asia** | **Atlas, Prometheus, Epimetheus, Menoetius** | Support, forethought, afterthought, transmission of crafts |
| **Crius + Eurybia** | Astraeus, Pallas, Perses | Astral and power-related descendant branches |
| **Mnemosyne + Zeus** | **Nine Muses** | Memory expressed through artistic and poetic functions |
| **Themis + Zeus** | Horae; Moirai in Hesiod's account | Order, seasons, justice, allotment |
